This update includes security, connection reliability, and session-switching improvements:
 
• Resolved an issue where relaunching an active PC connection could switch to an existing remote app session.
• Fixed the Connection Center active connection preview so it reflects and reopens the most recently visited session.
• Improved handling of missing or invalid saved usernames to help prevent connection failures.
• Improved authentication reliability when starting multiple connections and refined sign-in error handling.
• Made targeted security fixes for clipboard redirection, remote session watermarking, certificate parsing, and RDP licensing.
 
If you encounter any errors, you can contact us via Settings > Submit Feedback.

packages.name: iOS Microsoft Warehouse Management
packages.releaseNotes:
Release notes: version 4.2.0.0
Highlights
Media capture
Workers can take photos and videos and attach them to records. For example, a worker who finds damaged goods during receiving can photograph the damage and attach it to the license plate or item, so the damage is on record. The app automatically makes files smaller before upload, so uploads are fast and reliable.

Note: This feature is included in this version of the app, and you can try it now in demo mode. To use it with your own data, you need server version 10.0.50.0 or later.

Easier connection setup
A step-by-step setup that asks one question at a time replaces the long connection form. It includes help text and shows only the options that apply. The previous form is still available.

Sign in with a QR code
Frontline workers can sign in by scanning their badge and entering a PIN, instead of typing a username and password. On shared devices, each worker always signs in with their own account.

More control for administrators
With your device management tool, you can now:

Give each device a name so it's easier to identify (DeviceName).
Prevent users from changing the app settings (LockClientSettings) or the connection settings (LockConnectionSettings).
The app also checks for policy updates less often, which saves battery.

Fixed issues
Switching environments: Users can now switch between environments that use different accounts. Signing out of one connection no longer signs the user out of the others.
Missing information on menu items: Fixed empty cards when all the fields on a card were hidden.
Popup messages: When a worker chooses not to see a step instruction again, it now stays hidden.
Worker sign-in: Tapping the sign-in button several times no longer causes a "session busy" error.
Reconnect loop: When a session expires, Reconnect now asks the user to sign in again instead of retrying without end.
Connection list: Long connection lists now have a search field.
Scanner camera: The scanner camera image is no longer mirrored. Workers can also change this setting on each device.
Panels during loading: Panels that slide over the screen now close when a new page starts loading.
Physical numeric keypad: Quantities typed on a physical numeric keypad now appear correctly.
Suggested quantity: Suggested quantities above 20 now appear when the quantity spinner is set to automatic.

packages.name: iOS Microsoft Whiteboard
packages.releaseNotes:
Thanks everyone for using Whiteboard. Here's what's new in this version :) Please keep the feedback coming y'all! Enjoy.

CHANGELOG
* Smoother editing and faster saves for large drawings
* Faster drawing library loading
* Photo picker opens faster
* Creator Kit unlocks more reliably after purchase
* Fixes an issue with drawing on iOS 17 devices


2.0 Additions and Improvements
* Introducing SharePlay drawing, draw with others over FaceTime or Messages.
* Introducing Creator Kit, get the most out of Whiteboard and support Indie development
* Now you can zoom in and out on drawings and images!
* Scroll around in freedom on the all new, expansive, drawing board.
* Autorotate from portrait to landscape and back, or you can choose to lock orientation.
* Drawing library, open and continue working on your recent drawings.
* Add new drawing button, create a new drawing anytime.
* Significant performance and stability improvements
* Adds lock for drawing board zoom/pan/scroll
* Many more exciting things are coming
* Stay tuned

- Jim
